##### N. Builder package selection truth / Change package UX — IMPLEMENTED (2026-07-17)

**Status:** Draft-option scoped Builder package picker + one-option UX. **No migrations/SQL/package files/pricing formula/Customer Preview redesign/lifecycle/supplier/material/CSV/raw/whole-rounding. No “Start new draft.” No live-template option import into existing drafts.**

**Product rule (locked):**
- Pre-draft: package selection on Job Card Proposals tab
- Post-draft: package changes in Builder among **saved draft options only**
- Builder must not silently pull live Template options unless an explicit rebuild/refresh creates them

**Root cause:** Package selector UI listed `starterGraph.options` (live template by draft `template_id`). Persist path already required draft runtime option via `resolveRuntimeOptionIdFromTemplateOptionId` → `updateDraftSelectedOption`, but the picker could advertise live-only packages and still offered **Change package** on one-option drafts.

**Implementation:**
- `proposalBuilderDraftPackageOptions` — `scopeTemplateGraphToDraftPackageOptions` intersects live labels with draft `proposal_options`; drops live-only; synthesizes draft-only rows when needed
- Builder Client wires `packageSelectorGraph` + `draftScopedPackagePicker` into Canvas → EstimateDocument → PackageZone → PackageSelector
- One option: hide **Change package**; show “Only one package exists on this draft.”; no one-option radio picker
- Multi option: **Change package** shows draft options only; switch persists `selected_option_id`
- Job Card draft-open: optional note “Package changes happen in Builder for this draft.”

**Audit side effect:** R18D3B Email Smoke draft `368dcbf1-…` was left on **Enhanced** (acceptable for smoke; no revert).

**Smoke (local app on `rhquhnujjnzjhweypavd`):**

- Multi-option `9cd2c4ac-…` / `368dcbf1-…`: Change package → Standard / Enhanced / Premium only; switched Standard → Preview showed Standard; **reverted to Enhanced** (audit leave-as)
- No send/public/lifecycle/supplier/material/CSV actions

##### O. Job Card Proposals create flow restore + existing draft handling — IMPLEMENTED (2026-07-17)

**Status:** Existing draft no longer blocks create-new. Force-create path adds a distinct draft. **No migrations/SQL/package files/pricing formula/Customer Preview redesign/lifecycle/supplier/material/CSV/raw/whole-rounding. No full proposal management system.**

**Root cause:** Draft-aware Job Card overcorrected — `hasExistingDraft` hid create selectors; `resolveOrCreateProposalDraftEntry` always reused active/listed draft. Contractors with a wrong smoke draft (Babby) were trapped.

**Architecture decision:**
- Keep `resolveOrCreateProposalDraftEntry` for **Open existing** (reuse)
- Add `createNewProposalDraftEntry` for **Create new** — always calls `createDraftProposal` (sets `jobs.active_proposal_id` to the new id; never reuses)
- Store already supports many proposals per job; UI now exposes force-create

**Job Card Proposals UI:**
- **Existing draft** card — title, package, status, updated, Open in Builder (no live selectors mutating that draft)
- **Create another proposal** card — template/package/included + “This creates a separate draft. Existing drafts are not changed.”
- Bottom list can show multiple drafts with Open; Current marks active

**Builder package rule preserved:** Job Card chooses package before create; Builder switches among draft options after; one-option drafts still hide Change package.

**Smoke (Babby D on `rhquhnujjnzjhweypavd`):** Proposals tab `open_and_create` — existing smoke draft card + create-another with Roof replacement Standard/Enhanced/Premium; multi-draft list shows prior drafts including `61356e56-…` as Current; force-create API covered by unit tests. Live create click optional / deferred after UI verify; no send/lifecycle.

**Follow-on polish (committed `190ad66`):** Compact Current proposal + Start proposal zones; softened smoke titles via `formatContractorProposalTitle` → “Saved proposal”; older drafts collapsed behind “Show older drafts (N)”. Still not Flow V1 end-state (see **P**).

---

###### P.1 Product spine (unchanged)

**Catalog → Templates → Job Card → Builder → Customer Preview**

- **Catalog** = company item library (SoT for item economics)
- **Templates** = company setup (reusable quote shapes; not job proposal start)
- **Job Card → Proposals** = job-specific proposal start
- **Builder** = estimate / package / document workbench for a draft
- **Customer Preview** = contractor view of customer-facing document (authenticated; not public send)

---

###### P.2 Proposal Flow V1 (locked target)

**Happy path:**

1. Job Card → **Proposals** tab
2. Blue **+ Proposal** (primary create CTA)
3. Create modal / sheet: measurement (required gate) → template → package → included summary → **Continue to Builder**
4. Builder: estimate workbench; package change among **draft options only** (rule from **N** preserved)
5. **Preview** from Builder (dirty-edit guard preserved)
6. **Send later** — not in Flow V1 coding scope unless separately approved

**Proposals tab surface standard (locked):**

| Element | Rule |
|---------|------|
| Default view | Compact proposal **rows** (current + recent), not always-open setup cards / archive admin |
| Primary CTA | Blue **+ Proposal** |
| Open existing | Row action → Builder (reuse `resolveOrCreate` / open existing) |
| Create new | **+ Proposal** → modal → force-create (`createNewProposalDraftEntry`) → Builder |
| Older drafts | Collapsed / secondary; not the first impression |
| Smoke / internal | Hidden from normal contractor view (Block 1); **do not delete** |

**Not Proposal Flow V1:** full proposal management system; always-visible dual setup cards as the long-term IA; Templates page as job proposal start; live-template option import into existing drafts.

---

###### P.3 Template Flow V1 (locked target)

**Templates page = company setup**, not job proposal start.

**Role boundary (locked):**
- **Job Card → + Proposal** creates job-specific proposals.
- **Templates → + Template** creates reusable company setup.
- Templates should **not** feel like a giant admin workbook, raw database editor, or job-specific proposal creation page.

| Element | Rule |
|---------|------|
| Primary CTA | Blue **+ Template** (create / guided setup) |
| Default library | Compact template library **rows/cards** (not an always-expanded workbook) |
| Row/card shows | Template name; package model summary; linked catalog item count; readiness status; last updated; **Edit** action |
| Default use | Review readiness, packages, included items; open Jobs when ready to start a job proposal elsewhere |
| Edit | Explicit edit / continue guided setup for structure, packages, catalog links, content, estimate display |
| Proposal start | **Never** from Templates as the job create path — that stays Job Card → Proposals |

**+ Template guided flow (locked target):**

1. **Template basics**
   - name
   - trade/type
   - short description if useful

2. **Package model**
   Contractor chooses:
   - no packages / simple offer
   - single package
   - multiple packages

   Roofing baseline may default to:
   - Standard
   - Enhanced
   - Premium

   **Do not** force packages for every template.

3. **Define packages/options**
   - package names
   - customer-facing descriptions
   - internal notes secondary only

4. **Add included catalog items**
   - searchable catalog item picker
   - item name, type, measurement/quantity source, customer visibility
   - **do not** expose supplier SKU / internal cost as primary setup

5. **Proposal content/pages**
   - cover/page defaults
   - terms
   - warranty
   - customer estimate settings
   - optional upgrades if supported

6. **Review & save**
   - template name
   - package model
   - package count
   - linked item count
   - page/content readiness
   - **Save template**

Templates Page P2 / Quote Setup Review work remains valid company-setup UX foundation; Flow V1 locks the guided setup target and role boundary vs Proposals.

---

###### P.4 App-wide contractor OS surface standards (locked)

1. **One job per surface** — Proposals start proposals; Templates manage templates; Catalog manages items; Builder edits the draft document; Preview shows customer view.
2. **Compact command rows over always-open admin cards** on job operational tabs (Proposals first).
3. **Blue primary create** for the main “add” action on that surface (**+ Proposal**, **+ Template**, Catalog add patterns as already established).
4. **Setup vs run** — company setup (Catalog/Templates/Settings) vs job run (Job Card → Builder → Preview).
5. **Smoke / internal artifacts stay in DB** but must not dominate contractor UI (Block 1).
6. **Do not fake lifecycle** — no sent status, board moves, public links, PDF/sign/payment unless separately approved.

---

###### P.5 Smoke / internal proposal policy (locked)

- Keep smoke and internal proposals/templates in the database for engineering validation.
- **Do not delete** smoke drafts (e.g. Babby `61356e56-…`, R18 email smoke `368dcbf1-…`) as part of UI cleanup.
- **Hide** them from the normal contractor Proposals list / titles (Block 1 implementation).
- Softened titles (“Saved proposal”) from `190ad66` are interim; isolation is the durable policy.

###### P.6 Builder and Preview roles (locked)

| Surface | Role in Flow V1 |
|---------|-----------------|
| **Builder** | Estimate / package (draft options only) / document pages workbench. Entry from Job Card open or **+ Proposal** continue. Not a template editor. Not send orchestration. |
| **Customer Preview** | Authenticated contractor preview of customer document. Document-first truth polish may follow after Flow V1 handoff (Block 5). **Not** public/tokenized access, PDF, Sign, Payment, or Send orchestration in Blocks 0–4. |

Package rule from **N** remains law: pre-draft package on create modal; post-draft package changes in Builder among saved draft options only.

###### T.7 Block 6 — Template Flow V1 foundation + Job Card template eligibility — IMPLEMENTED (2026-07-21)

**Code checkpoint:** **`d877df6`** — `feat(proposals): add guided template creation flow`. **Docs checkpoint:** pending this docs commit. **Working tree was clean before this docs-only edit.**

**Status:** Template Flow V1 foundation is complete. The Templates page creates and edits reusable company proposal setups; the Job Card consumes a usable setup to create a job-specific proposal. No app code, tests, migrations, SQL, or package files are changed by this docs checkpoint.

**Template Flow V1 foundation:**
- Added the blue primary **+ Template** CTA and guided create path.
- Guided overlay order: **Basics → Package model → Prepared structure → Create**.
- Package models: **Simple estimate / no packages**, **Single package**, and **Standard / Enhanced / Premium**.
- Added pure planner/helper architecture for guided creation.
- Guided creation materializes through the existing graph: **ProposalTemplate → Options/packages → Sections → Items**.
- No SQL/migrations were required. No `app/lib` store/install helper changes were required; the guided helper uses the existing proposal-template store graph operations.
- Creation lands on the selected-template setup area, formerly framed as Quote Setup Review and now reframed as reusable setup.

**Reusable proposal setup landing correction:**
- Primary framing is **Reusable proposal setup**, not an admin “Quote Setup Review.”
- Packages appear as prepared choices; included work appears as a prepared summary.
- **Add / Replace / Remove** remain available but are visually secondary.
- Proposal content summary names **Overview, Estimate, Scope notes, Warranty, Terms**.
- Next use is quiet: use the template from a Job Card when creating a proposal.
- Advanced editing remains available but secondary.
- The dominant Open Jobs CTA, readiness-hero feel, no-create footnote, and admin/review tone were removed or de-emphasized.

**Job Card selected-template eligibility correction:**
- Root cause: Job Card → + Proposal → Template incorrectly gated the selected template on company starter readiness. Starter readiness requires the starter shape and therefore blocked guided single-package templates; it could also misfire while usable templates existed.
- Proposal-create eligibility now checks the **selected graph** for at least one usable package/option, linked items, no link issues, and a graph usable for draft creation.
- Company starter readiness remains scoped to Templates/company setup only.
- Ready starter and guided-created templates advance **Template → Package**.
- A not-ready template does not globally block other ready templates.
- The orange setup blocker appears only when no templates exist or the selected template is truly unusable. Readiness stays quiet while the selected graph is loading or the flow is otherwise self-explanatory.

**Product model lock:**
- **Templates page is setup-only.** It creates reusable proposal setups, not job-specific proposals and not proposal drafts.
- **Job Card remains the normal proposal creation path.** It uses reusable setups to create job-specific proposals.
- Locked flow: **Job Card → Proposals → + Proposal → Measurement → Template → Package → Review → Builder → Preview → Send/share**.
- Do not make Templates the normal proposal-start path.

**Presentation-driven product standard:**
- Present prepared choices and clear next steps so the contractor can choose and move forward.
- Do not make contractors manually assemble proposal templates from raw database parts.
- Do not use admin/database language as the primary experience.
- Advanced/manual editing may exist, but it stays secondary.
- Future prompts should choose the best durable product direction and control scope around it—not default to the “smallest/easiest” change.

**Readiness and guidance principle:**
- Do not overbuild readiness.
- Readiness is quiet by default and becomes prominent only when it blocks a real action or protects customer-facing truth.
- Avoid warning/checklist/nagging tone in self-explanatory flows.

###### T.8 Optional Upgrade Truth — ACCEPTED (2026-07-21)

**Checkpoints:**
- **Code:** **`a28224c`** — `chore(proposals): align optional upgrade truth RPCs`.
- **Previous feature:** **`32964d6`** — `feat(proposals): implement optional upgrade truth`.
- **Docs:** **`4b9e711`** — `docs: record optional upgrade truth acceptance checkpoint`.
- **Working tree:** clean before Authorship V1 code commit **`ab3a776`**; this T.8 block is historical acceptance record only.

**Acceptance:** Optional Upgrade Truth is accepted after live schema/RPC, installed-template repair, Builder create/select/refresh/reload, Preview, send-freeze, and public proposal verification on approved Supabase project **`rhquhnujjnzjhweypavd`**.

**Locked product model:**
- Package-included enhancements belong in normal **`line_items`** scope.
- True optional add-ons belong in **`upgrade_group`** and are default unselected.
- Unselected upgrades do not affect subtotal, sales tax, internal cost, profit, or total.
- A selected additive upgrade contributes to totals exactly once.
- Selected upgrade truth persists at proposal-version/option scope and freezes into immutable sent truth.
- Builder, contractor Preview, and public proposal presentation expose selected-only upgrade truth.

**App, schema, and RPC checkpoints:**
- **`32964d6`** implemented Optional Upgrade Truth across app model, pricing gates, persistence adapters, Builder controls, Preview/public presentation, starter v2 defaults, and focused tests.

**Checkpoints:**

**Acceptance boundary:** **R1 accepted as package-option structure authorship.** It does **not** complete:
- full Templates lifecycle
- content editor
- estimate display editor
- full template archive/default management
- package model conversion after create
- mobile polish

**R1 accepted scope:**
- Package-option structure authorship after template creation.
- One template can contain many package options.
- **R1 Adjust packages** modifies package options inside the selected template.
- It does **not** create new templates.
- **Copy existing** package is guided and default.
- **Start blank** is a guided package shell.
- Package options can be reordered.
- Default package option can be changed.
- Package options can be removed from future use through soft-remove (`removed_at`).
- Active package-option count updates Templates and Job Card.
- Builder uses draft **`proposal_options`** truth, not live template options after draft creation.

**Product model (locked hierarchy):**

| Surface | Role |
|---------|------|
| **Templates** | Manage reusable setup and package options |
| **+ Template** | Guided create-time starter model: **One package** · **Two packages** · **Three packages** · **Custom package setup** |
| **Templates → Adjust packages** | Post-create package-option management: **Copy existing** · **Start blank shell** · **Reorder** · **Remove from setup** · **Set default** |
| **Job Card** | Select template, then select one package option only if there are **2+** active package options |
| **Builder** | Use proposal draft’s copied **`proposal_options`**. Show all proposal options copied into that draft. Do **not** rely on live template package options after draft creation |
| **Preview / Public** | Use frozen **`proposal_options`** snapshot truth |

**Dynamic package-option truth:**
- Active package options = **`proposal_template_options` where `removed_at` is null**, sorted by **`sort_order`**.
- **4+** package options are supported.
- Copy says **“package options”** to avoid confusing package options with templates.
- No hardcoded Good/Better/Best or 3-option assumptions in active-use flows.
- Good/Better/Best remains a **starter setup pattern only**, not a permanent model limit.

**SQL / migration:**
- Migration: **`supabase/migrations/20260722_031_add_proposal_template_option_removed_at.sql`**.
- **Applied live** to Supabase project **`rhquhnujjnzjhweypavd`**.
- Adds **`proposal_template_options.removed_at`**.
- Adds active/removed indexes.
- Keeps sent proposal history intact.
- Does **not** modify **`proposal_options`**.
- Does **not** loosen immutability guard.
- Soft-remove means **“remove from future setup use,”** not delete historical proposal truth.

###### T.9 R2A Template archive / restore lifecycle — ACCEPTED (2026-07-22)

**Checkpoints:**

- **Docs:** **`6d53906`** — `docs: record R2A template archive restore checkpoint`.

**Acceptance boundary:** **R2A is accepted as template archive/restore lifecycle only.** It does **not** include:
- preferred setup / company default template (**R2B** — now accepted separately)
- template delete
- package-option remove (R1 soft-remove remains separate)
- content editor
- estimate display editor
- package model conversion
- mobile polish

**R2A accepted scope:**
- Template archive
- Template restore
- Templates **Active / Archived** lifecycle UI
- Calm archive confirmation modal
- Archived templates hidden from future Job Card proposal creation
- Job Card default resolver never selects archived templates
- Sticky selected archived template is cleared/replaced
- Archive/restore writes template **`status` + `active` together**

**Data model:**
- **No SQL/migration required.**
- Uses existing **`proposal_templates.status`** and **`proposal_templates.active`**.
- Archive sets **`status='archived'`** and **`active=false`**.
- Restore sets **`status='active'`** and **`active=true`**.
- **`status`** is the lifecycle source of truth; **`active`** is kept synced to prevent drift.

**Product rule — Archive template means:**
- Hide reusable setup from future proposal creation
- Move/hide it from the active Templates library
- Keep the template row
- Keep package options, sections, and items
- Keep existing drafts/sent proposals unchanged
- Allow restore later

**Archive does NOT mean:**
- Delete the template
- Delete package options
- Set **`proposal_template_options.removed_at`**
- Mutate **`proposal_versions`**
- Mutate **`proposal_options`**
- Mutate **`proposal_line_items`**
- Hide old sent proposals
- Break Builder/Preview/Public for existing proposals

**Surface behavior:**

| Surface | Behavior |
|---------|----------|
| **Templates** | Active / Archived filter; **Archive** on active rows; **Restore** on archived rows; **no Delete** in R2A |
| **Job Card** | Archived templates excluded from template picker; cannot be initial/default selection; restored templates return to picker |
| **Builder / Preview / Public** | Existing proposals created from archived templates still open and use proposal snapshot truth; **no** filtering by live template status |

**Tests and smoke:**
- **95/95** focused tests passed (**0** fail) — R2A lifecycle + R1 / Job Card / Builder regression.
- Live archive → restore → Job Card exclusion smoke **PASS**.
- Browser console: **0** errors.

Archive path in `archiveProposalTemplate` clears matching preference; restore does not call set/clear preferred.

**Surface behavior:**

| Surface | Behavior |
|---------|----------|
| **Templates** | Active non-preferred → **Make preferred**; preferred → **Preferred** badge + helper (“Used first when starting a proposal from a Job Card.”) + **Clear preferred**; archived → Restore only (no Make preferred / Preferred badge) |
| **Job Card** | Resolution order: (1) preferred setup if still eligible (non-archived, `active !== false`), (2) starter `seed_key`, (3) first active eligible, (4) first eligible. Package-option step remains R1 `is_default` / sort_order |
| **Archive / restore** | Archive preferred → clear preference; archive non-preferred → no preference change; restore formerly preferred → **not** auto-preferred; user must **Make preferred** again |

##### Locked product distinctions (do not combine)

| Concept | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| **Attention** | An operational condition requiring contractor review/action (`job_attention_items`) |
| **Task** | Planned work with owner and/or due date — **separate system**; customer requests do **not** automatically create tasks |
| **Activity** | Chronological durable history of what occurred |
| **Stage** | The job’s pipeline position (`jobs.stage` / Jobs Board lane) — **canonical model LIVE at §6BP** |
| **Personal read** | Individual consumption state only (`job_attention_user_state`) — never acknowledges or resolves attention |
| **Acknowledged** | Company-level reviewed/claimed attention state — **remains active** |
| **Resolved** | No further contractor action remains — excluded from operational surfaces |
| **Email sent** | Delivery state only — never acknowledges or resolves attention |

Customer request = attention. It is **not** automatically a task. It does **not** change job stage or proposal lifecycle.

**C4 supersession rule (locked):** C4 supersedes customer **email access to OLDER proposal versions**, not merely older token issuance.

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| **Same-version resend** | Old same-version email token stays active; new same-version email token active; both show identical immutable current content; neither says a newer proposal exists |
| **Newer revision send** | Active older-version `contractor_email_send` tokens become superseded; new token points to latest sent frozen version; old token remains permanently bound to its old version; old token resolves **superseded** — no redirect, no replacement URL, no new-version content leak |

**Authoritative C4 boundary — combined RPC `mint_and_supersede_proposal_public_access_token_v1`:**

- `service_role` only · SECURITY DEFINER · explicit `search_path`
- Current proposal `latest_sent_version_id` only · sent version only · frozen truth required
- Token category canonicalized to `contractor_email_send`
- Proposal row lock · transactional mint + older-version supersession
- **Authoritative supersession point:** new immutable sent version + new email-send token successfully established — **do NOT wait for Resend provider acceptance**
- **Delivery failure:** sent version remains current; `latest_sent_version_id` remains new version; current token remains active; old-version tokens remain superseded; delivery attempt = failed; **no freeze rollback; no token rollback**

###### Locked composition domain model

**Product identity is NOT composition identity.**

Catalog product identity:
- `catalog_item_id`
- `catalog_seed_key` / provenance

Composition identity:
- `composition_role`
- `composition_slot_key`

`composition_role` = functional family of the scope item. Examples: `roof_covering`, `underlayment`, `ice_water`, `ventilation`, `install_labor`, `tear_off`, `disposal`, `permit`.

`composition_slot_key` = stable instance of that functional role inside a package group. Examples: `roof_covering`, `ice_water.valleys`, `ice_water.eaves`, `ventilation.additional`.

Role alone is **not** sufficient where multiple same-role items can exist.

###### Locked ownership

| Owner | Owns | Does not own |
|-------|------|----------------|
| **Catalog** | default `composition_role` for a product | `composition_slot_key` |
| **Template item** | copied `composition_role`; authoritative `composition_slot_key` | live proposal membership |
| **Draft proposal line** | role + slot copied at create; then proposal-owned | live Template rehydration |
| **Refresh** | preserves draft role + slot; Catalog may refresh approved economics | live Template composition fields |
| **Frozen sent version** | copies role + slot from draft when sent | rewriting historical sent/signed/superseded rows |

This preserves **V2E1 Template→draft isolation**.

###### Generic composition engine contract

V2E2 introduced a reusable deterministic composition domain. The engine is **not** Templates-only.

Generic package composition comparison supports:
- arbitrary package names
- arbitrary package counts
- arbitrary A↔B comparison
- ordered step-up chain

Default step-up:
- P1 = base
- P2 compared to P1
- P3 compared to P2
- P4 compared to P3
- …

This is **DERIVED presentation/intelligence only**. Every package remains an explicit complete persisted composition.

**NO stored inheritance. NO runtime inheritance.**

Matching:
1. group + unique `composition_slot_key`
2. exact provenance/product fallback
3. add/remove fallback

Classifications:
- `UNCHANGED`
- `LABEL_ONLY`
- `PRODUCT_REPLACEMENT`
- `QUANTITY_CHANGE`
- `ADDED_INCLUDED_SCOPE`
- `REMOVED_INCLUDED_SCOPE`
- `OPTIONAL_UPGRADE_ADDED`
- `OPTIONAL_UPGRADE_REMOVED`
- `OPTIONAL_UPGRADE_CHANGED`

No product-name heuristics. Duplicate group+slot: engine does not arbitrarily pair rows; ambiguity is recorded / handled conservatively; no false confident `PRODUCT_REPLACEMENT`.

###### Composition vs pricing boundary (locked)

Composition engine answers: **“What structurally changed?”**
Pricing engine answers: **“What does this job cost?”**

Composition may carry unit economics context for explanation.

Composition engine must **NOT**:
- compute proposal totals
- apply taxes
- apply profitability policy
- duplicate measurement pricing
- invent package premiums

Proposal option totals remain authoritative pricing truth. Do not blur these systems.

###### V2E2 authoring contract

**Add included product**
- Catalog-backed
- copies Catalog `composition_role`
- assigns stable slot
- avoids ambiguous duplicate slot behavior

**Replace product**
- preserves `composition_role`
- preserves `composition_slot_key`
- changes Catalog product identity
- clears/reconciles stale customer wording when needed
- same slot + different product becomes `PRODUCT_REPLACEMENT`

**Remove**
- explicit package-row removal through existing path

**Quantity**
- Catalog quantity is default/quiet
- contractor opens Quantity only when needed
- supports Catalog/inherit vs fixed quantity
- future proposals receive Template quantity rule
- existing drafts remain isolated

**Optional upgrades**
- structurally separate from included scope
- package-specific
- default unselected
- not confused with included enhancements

**Role-aware replace picker**
- compatible composition-role products preferred
- broader Catalog browsing remains deliberate
- incompatible product choice requires explicit handling
- internal role/slot codes are not exposed to contractor

Default Templates experience remains light: **Base package** or **N changes from Previous** + **View changes**. Progressive disclosure: View changes / Quantity / Replace.

##### B. Confirmed Roofr workflow findings

1. **Catalog is the item library for proposals and material orders** — materials, labor, and other resources live in Catalog; they appear on proposals and can feed material orders (Create a Catalog help).
2. **Contractor setup order is Catalog → Templates → Proposals from Job** — templates require catalog items first; proposal create is from a job with a measurement report, then template selection (Create Proposal / Create Template help).
3. **Templates link catalog items; they do not re-edit catalog economics** — “Add item from catalog”; “You can not edit catalog item details at the template level” (Create Template help).
4. **Proposal compile automates quantities from measurement + catalog/template mapping** — Roofr combines report measurements with material amounts from catalog items and template (Create Proposal help).
5. **Customer-facing simplicity is controlled by estimate display settings** — show/hide line item details (subtotals, quantity, unit prices) at template and proposal estimate settings (Create Template / Customize proposal help).
6. **Sales tax vs purchase tax are distinct on catalog items** — sales tax = tax customer pays; material purchase tax = tax paid when purchasing materials (Create a Catalog help). CSV columns include `TAX_RATE` and `PURCHASE_TAX` (CSV format help).
7. **Supplier SKUs are storage columns on CSV** — `ABC_SKU`, `BEACON_SKU` (QXO), `SRS_SKU` (CSV format help). Connecting live supplier pricing is a separate integration flow (ABC guide / supplier history import).
8. **CSV import is template-strict** — column headers must remain as provided; do not rearrange/remove; Name required; other columns optional but still present; empty UUID = create, present UUID = update (CSV format + Create Catalog help). Public docs describe **no interactive column-mapping UI** for arbitrary supplier CSVs.
9. **Jumpstart / roofing-system import** is a first-class onboarding path separate from blank CSV (Create Catalog + masterclass + ABC guide).
10. **Material orders come after a won proposal (or from scratch / template)** — “Create material order” from won proposal populates materials; Job Card has Material orders tab (Material Order help). Supplier item connect can happen at order stage (Connect supplier items help).
11. **Reorder / bulk / drag-drop** — FieldDive already mirrors Roofr-like Catalog command surface; Roofr DnD specifics for catalog reorder are **not** fully documented in the public pages reviewed (treat UI mechanics as partially unconfirmed).

##### D. Current FieldDive spine (as implemented)

```
Setup (company):
  Catalog (/tools/roofing/catalog)
    → Templates (/tools/roofing/templates) [catalog readiness gate]
Daily work:
  Job Board (/tools/roofing/saved)
    → Job Card (job=) — checklist gates
    → Create/Open draft (Job Card only)
    → Builder (?job=&proposal=) — snapshot display; refresh re-prices from live catalog
    → Contractor Customer Preview (?job=&proposal=)
Future:
  Job Card Material Orders tab (stub) ← proposal lines + catalog SKUs/qty
```

| Stage | Current truth |
|-------|----------------|
| **Catalog** | Company SoT for item economics, measurement mapping, coverage/waste/basis, item tax capture, supplier SKU storage, CSV v1, selection/bulk/reorder |
| **Templates** | Structure + `catalog_item_id` links (install resolves `catalog_seed_key` → id). **No price overrides** on template items. Prerequisite banner when catalog not ready. **No first-class “Add item from catalog” picker UI** (Planned bulk/copy only) |
| **Draft create** | Job Card → `createDraftProposal`: template graph + **live** catalog + measurement + policy → pricing engine → snapshots |
| **Builder** | With `proposal=`: reads **snapshots**. Refresh reloads live catalog + template + measurement and rewrites snapshots. Without `proposal=`: live starter preview only (cannot create DB draft) |
| **Preview** | Customer-safe pages/lines; omits unit cost, profit, purchase tax, supplier SKUs; company policy sales tax drives totals; catalog item tax rates **not** wired into line tax |
| **Material orders** | Job Card stub + Catalog Planned bulk “Add to proposal / material order”; SKUs stored for future |

##### E. FieldDive integrated flow map (target long-term)

**1. Catalog source-of-truth role**

Belongs in Catalog:
- Item identity (name, type, unit, active/sort)
- Economics (unit cost/price, pricing basis, labor cost)
- Quantity drivers (measurement source, coverage, coverage basis, waste)
- Customer presentation defaults (customer name/description, proposal visibility)
- Tax capture (sales tax rate capture; purchase tax internal)
- Supplier SKU storage (ABC/QXO/SRS) — **not** live sync
- CSV maintenance of the above

Does **not** belong in Catalog:
- Per-job quantities / selected package choices
- Proposal page copy / branding / tokens
- Customer document assembly
- Send/lifecycle/payment
- Live supplier auth/pricing sync (separate integration stage)
- Material order logistics (branch, delivery, PO) — order surface later

**2. Template integration**

- Templates compose **which catalog items** appear in which option/section and estimate display settings.
- Templates must **reference** `catalog_item_id` (and may retain seed keys for install defaults) — **never duplicate** unit price/cost/tax/SKU as competing SoT.
- Target UX (Roofr-aligned): **Add item from catalog** in template option editor; cannot edit catalog economics on the template.
- FieldDive starter install already resolves seed→id; durable gap is contractor **picker + unlink/replace** without reinstall.

**3. Proposal Builder integration**

- Draft create/refresh pulls: template structure + **live CatalogItem** economics/drivers + measurement + company pricing policy.
- Builder with persisted `proposal=` displays **snapshots** (stable contractor document); refresh is the intentional re-sync from live catalog.
- Visibility/tax/coverage truth:
  - Visibility: catalog default → proposal line display status (existing snapshot path)
  - Coverage/waste: apply per company waste model (default adjusted ignores catalog coverage; raw remains gated — **no Settings switch yet**)
  - Sales tax: company policy remains authoritative for proposal totals until an approved item-line-tax stage
  - Purchase tax / SKUs: internal; available to future ordering/cost views — never customer canvas

**4. Customer Preview integration**

Customer sees: branded pages, customer-facing names/descriptions, allowed line presentation, option totals/tax per estimate display policy.
Customer never sees: unit cost, purchase tax, supplier SKUs, internal margin/profit, catalog-only internal fields.
Contractor Preview remains the trust gate before public send (R18 path unchanged by this research).

**5. Material ordering future integration**

Natural join (Roofr-aligned):
- Input: won/selected proposal option lines (`catalog_item_id`, quantity, unit) + Catalog SKUs + purchase tax + supplier connection
- Surface: Job Card Material Orders (already stubbed) — **not** Catalog page as the order editor
- Catalog’s job beforehand: durable SKUs + internal cost/purchase tax + correct quantities via proposal math
- Do **not** invent ordering until Catalog→Template→Proposal quantity/SKU trust is solid

**6. CSV / import integration**

- **Now (v1):** Strict FieldDive CSV headers (`catalogCsv.ts`) — exact column order; blank `id` = create; id = company-scoped update; preview then import; SKUs persist; no sync.
- **Future (P2):** Behind-the-scenes **CSV mapping/import assistant** for non-matching uploads:
  - Detect uploaded headers
  - Map columns → FieldDive fields
  - Preview unmatched / ignored columns
  - Save reusable mappings (incl. supplier-specific shapes later)
  - Keep strict FieldDive CSV as the clean baseline export/template
- **Do not build mapping yet.** Jumpstart/supplier-priced starter remains Planned (separate from Install starter catalog).

**7. Job page / main workflow integration**

- Catalog stays a **Setup** workspace; Job Card links when readiness fails (`JobCardProposalsSetupLinks`).
- Daily path: Job Board → Job Card → Create proposal → Builder → Preview.
- Catalog must not become a job editor; Job Card must not become a catalog editor.
- Material Orders tab later consumes proposal readiness — already the correct stub location.

**8. Contractor-simple flow (target)**

1. Setup Catalog (starter install and/or CSV / future Jumpstart) — price + map measurements + coverage/waste as needed
2. Setup Templates (add/confirm catalog items on options; estimate display)
3. Open Job → ensure measurement → Create proposal from template
4. Review/adjust in Builder → Preview as customer
5. Later: send/sign (R18+) → Create material order from won proposal

Roofr keeps this simple by: forcing Catalog-before-Template, automating qty from measurement mapping, hiding internal cost/tax complexity from the customer document, and deferring supplier connect to catalog/order stages—not the first proposal click.

## 6BP. JOB LIFECYCLE / STAGE MODEL — COMPLETE / LIVE / VERIFIED (2026-08-16)

**Status:** **COMPLETE / LIVE / VERIFIED.** Canonical owner for Job stage, stage transitions, Time in stage, disposition separation, job-native Activity, Job Card stage truth, and Jobs Board lane truth. Future features **must use this foundation**. Do **not** add raw `jobs.stage` writes elsewhere.

**Code checkpoint:** **`7510abd`** — `feat(jobs): add canonical job lifecycle foundation`. **Migration:** **`20260816_038_job_lifecycle_foundation.sql`** authored, applied, verified live on **`rhquhnujjnzjhweypavd`**, committed at **`7510abd`**. **038 permanently means Job Lifecycle Foundation.** Deferred C4 generic-email-mint hardening is **039 or later** (not authored, not applied). Do **not** modify applied migration 037.

**Proposal Flow V2:** remains **COMPLETE / LOCKED** at **`dbea772`**.

**Sequencing lock:** **R3D is COMPLETE / LIVE** at **`0d06ad8`**. See **§6BR**. Next: **R3E planning** unless another approved roadmap gate precedes it.

**Historical note:** §6BP was approved as plan-only at docs **`04f5290`** (2026-08-15). That historical plan remains the Job-stage architecture. The R3C **AUTO Proposal → Approved** row in **6BP.3 / 6BP.25** is **superseded by §6BQ**: customer Accept does **not** move Job stage; explicit contractor **Approve job** does.

### 6BP.1 Core separation (do not collapse)

| Concept | Meaning | Must NOT become |
|---------|---------|-----------------|
| **Job stage** | Broad operational phase (`jobs.stage`) | Proposal Sent, payment state, Attention, Activity |
| **Proposal state** | Proposal-specific lifecycle (Draft / Sent / Revision in progress / later Accepted / Declined / Expired) | Job stage or board lane |
| **Financial state** | Money/payment truth (None / Deposit due / Deposit paid / Balance due / Payment failed / Paid in full) | Job stage or board lane |
| **Attention** | Current actionable condition requiring contractor review | Task, stage, proposal state, Activity history |
| **Activity** | Durable chronological operational/customer facts | Attention, UI telemetry, personal read |
| **Tasks** | Explicit planned work with owner/due | Automatic stage gates (except truth-critical prerequisites) |
| **Disposition** | `jobs.status`: active / on_hold / lost / closed | Job stage |
| **Archived** | `jobs.archived` visibility/storage flag | Operational stage |

Future features must **not** collapse proposal state, payment state, Attention, Activity, or task state into `jobs.stage`.

### 6BP.2 Canonical Job stages

**Six canonical stages:**

```
Intake → Proposal → Approved → Scheduled → Production → Complete
```

**Not canonical stages** (subordinate truth or other systems):

- Measurement, Estimating — subordinate workflow/readiness; read-map to Intake
- Proposal Sent, Proposal Viewed, Revision in progress — **proposal states**
- Deposit due, Deposit paid, Invoiced, Paid — **financial states**
- Archived — **visibility/storage**, not a stage

### 6BP.3 Job stage transition rules

| Event | Stage effect | Mode |
|-------|--------------|------|
| New job | AUTO → **Intake** | AUTO |
| First real proposal created | AUTO Intake → **Proposal** | AUTO — do **not** wait until Send |
| Proposal sent | Remain **Proposal** | — |
| Customer request / question | Remain **Proposal** | — |
| Revision started / revision sent | Remain **Proposal** | — |
| Formal acceptance (latest sent, no dirty revision, valid) | Remain **Proposal** + Attention | **SUPERSEDED by §6BQ** — no AUTO_APPROVE |
| Contractor Approve job (explicit, after acceptance) | Proposal → **Approved** | MANUAL / guarded — **§6BQ** |
| Formal acceptance (older version / dirty revision / later stage) | Remain current stage + Attention + Acknowledge | **§6BQ** — no stage regression |
| Approved → Scheduled | Canonical edge exists | **NOT enabled until R3F** has authoritative production appointment |
| Scheduled → Production | Explicit Start work | MANUAL / guarded |
| Calendar date arrives | **Does NOT** auto-start Production | — |
| Production → Complete | Explicit Complete | MANUAL / guarded |
| Payment / deposit / invoice | **Never** changes Job stage directly | — |

**Reschedule within Scheduled** does not change stage.

### 6BP.4 Stage vs disposition (separate guarded actions)

**A. `transitionJobStage(...)`** — canonical stage edges only:

Intake → Proposal → Approved → Scheduled → Production → Complete

**B. `changeJobDisposition(...)`** — disposition only:

active · on_hold · lost · closed

Disposition changes **preserve** current `jobs.stage` and **do not** reset `stage_entered_at`.

Example: `stage=proposal`, `status=lost`. Reopen → `status=active`, **stage remains Proposal**. No previous-stage guessing.

`won` is **not** a legal new disposition target.

### 6BP.5 Deprecate `jobs.status='won'`

Current DB CHECK permits: active, on_hold, won, lost, closed, archived.

**Future operational writes:** active, on_hold, lost, closed only.

**Sold/won operational truth:** **Approved** or a later canonical stage. Do **not** create a second sold truth.

**Legacy read compatibility:**

- `status=won` + stage already approved/production/complete/(later scheduled) → **stage wins**
- `status=won` + intake/measurement/estimating/proposal → **read/display as Approved** until guarded backfill
- `status=won` + `stage=archived` → use legacy archived resolution rules (§6BP.6)

Backfill later after sample verification; then stop reading/writing `won` and eventually tighten CHECK.

### 6BP.6 Archived ownership

| Field | Future ownership |
|-------|------------------|
| `jobs.stage` | Last meaningful operational stage |
| `jobs.status` | Disposition (active / on_hold / lost / closed) |
| `jobs.archived` | Visibility/storage flag |

**Examples:**

- Completed archived: `stage=complete`, `status=closed`, `archived=true`
- Lost archived: `stage=proposal` (or prior stage), `status=lost`, `archived=true`

Do **not** write `stage='archived'` or `status='archived'` going forward.

**Legacy `stage='archived'` — do NOT blindly map to Complete.** Resolution order:

1. `status=lost` → treat as **Proposal** unless later operational truth says otherwise
2. `status=won` → treat as **Approved**
3. `status=closed` + trustworthy completed legacy truth → **Complete**
4. Active proposal / latest sent → **Proposal**
5. Otherwise → **Intake**

Backfill only after sample verification.

### 6BP.7 Proposal states (subordinate)

Draft · Sent · Revision in progress · later Accepted · Declined · Expired

V2F contractor state at **`c54fc0a`** remains **derived** from version graph + dirty truth. Do **not** use `proposals.status` as Job Card / Jobs Board truth unless a future approved migration deliberately changes ownership.

Valid combined example: **Job stage = Proposal**, **Proposal = Revision in progress**.

### 6BP.8 Financial states (subordinate)

None · Deposit due · Deposit paid · Balance due · Payment failed · Paid in full

- Never chooses Jobs Board lane
- May create Attention
- May appear as quiet Job Card indicator

Valid examples: Approved + Deposit due; Scheduled + Deposit paid; Production + Balance due; Complete + Paid in full.

### 6BP.9 Attention contract

Attention = current actionable condition (customer request, later send failure, payment failed, overdue task, approved-but-unscheduled aging).

- Temporary/actionable; dismiss/handle does **not** delete Activity
- Do **not** auto-create Tasks unless a real task is intentionally created
- Command Center **R3B4C** consumes Attention, not Job stage

### 6BP.10 Activity contract

Activity = durable chronological facts another person could ask **"What happened?"**

**Include later:** job created, measurement completed, proposal created, proposal sent, revision sent, customer request, formal acceptance, signature completed, deposit received, payment failed, scheduled, rescheduled, production started, job completed, invoice sent, final payment received, lost, closed/cancelled, reopened.

**Do NOT include:** Job Card opened, Estimate loaded, Builder opened, Preview opened, tab clicks, autosave, field edits, quantity keystrokes, mark seen/read, `draft_saved`, `snapshot_frozen`.

**Explicit:** Synthetic **"Job card opened"** Activity was temporary UI behavior and **must not** return. Foundation Activity is durable history, not interaction telemetry.

### 6BP.11 Durable Activity ownership (architectural direction)

Activity UI is a **read model** over durable domain facts. Do **not** require every domain event duplicated into one table.

**Thin future `job_activity_events` (or equivalent)** owns **job-native** facts: job created, stage changed, disposition changed, scheduled/rescheduled (job-native), production started, completed, reopened.

**Native domain owners (composed, not dual-written):**

- Proposal sent/revised → `proposal_events` (allowlisted types only)
- Customer request → `proposal_customer_requests`
- Payment → financial/payment truth
- Delivery → `proposal_delivery_attempts` — not normal Activity

**Do NOT surface:** `draft_saved`, `previewed`, `snapshot_frozen`, delivery-attempt noise, read-state events.

Do **not** dual-write proposal sent into both `proposal_events` and `job_activity_events` merely to populate Activity.

`job_stage_transitions` table is **not required now**; stage-change Activity row is sufficient unless analytics prove otherwise.

### 6BP.12 Attention vs Activity

Same underlying event **may** appear in both:

- **Activity:** Customer requested Enhanced.
- **Attention:** Customer requested Enhanced — Review proposal.

When Attention is dismissed/handled, Activity remains. Do **not** duplicate the event again as Proposal lifecycle state.

### 6BP.13 Tasks contract

Tasks = planned work (Call customer, Upload permit, Order materials, Schedule crew).

Task completion does **not** normally change Job stage. Default: **warn, do not block** unless a prerequisite is truth-critical (e.g. cannot enter Scheduled without real production appointment once R3F owns that truth). Do **not** make arbitrary task checklists stage gates.

### 6BP.14 Time in stage

**Future authoritative field (now LIVE):** `jobs.stage_entered_at`

- Set when entering a canonical stage; reset **only** on actual stage change
- Do **not** reset on: send, revision, reschedule within Scheduled, payment, Attention, tasks, **on_hold disposition in V1**

**V1 On Hold:** stage clock **keeps counting**. No paused-duration math before durable history exists.

**Legacy / missing clock:** For remapped legacy rows, leave `stage_entered_at` **NULL** until first trustworthy canonical transition unless a real historical stage-entry timestamp can be proven. UI **omits** "Time in stage" when not trustworthy. Do **not** show `created_at` as fake Time in stage.

### 6BP.15 Scheduled timing

**Scheduled** is canonical in the model now.

Lifecycle foundation **added** `scheduled` to schema/types/CHECK (write-ban until R3F).

**`transitionJobStage` MUST reject Approved → Scheduled until R3F** owns authoritative production appointment truth.

**Jobs Board:** **Do NOT show an empty Scheduled lane before R3F.** Lane appears when scheduling capability is real.

After R3F: Approved → Scheduled available; Scheduled lane visible; valid production appointment required.

### 6BP.16 Complete decision

Complete remains canonical stage **and** Jobs Board lane. Do **not** replace Complete with Paid. Operational completion and financial completion are separate. Later UI may filter/archive older Complete jobs; stage remains Complete.

### 6BP.17 Job Card ownership

**Header / metadata owns:** canonical Job stage, truthful Time in stage, disposition when non-active, quiet subordinate summaries.

**Tabs own deeper systems:** Proposals → proposal state/history; Measurements → report state; Calendar → scheduling; Invoices → financial state; Tasks → planned work; Work orders → production execution.

**Attention:** act-now notice. **Activity:** chronological history. Do not repeat subordinate states as new stages.

### 6BP.18 Jobs Board ownership

**ONE JOB · ONE CURRENT JOB STAGE · ONE LANE**

Canonical lanes (when all capabilities exist): Intake · Proposal · Approved · Scheduled · Production · Complete

**Before R3F:** hide Scheduled lane.

Lane membership = canonical `jobs.stage` only. Secondary indicators (proposal state, Attention, assignee, schedule date, financial warning, task due) **never** determine lane.

On hold / Lost / Closed = filters/parked. Archived = hidden from working board (`archived=false` filter).

### 6BP.19 Pre-foundation Jobs Board contradictions (resolved for canonical DB jobs)

Before **`7510abd`**, the Jobs Board mixed stage, proposal, payment, and legacy estimate truth. Canonical DB jobs now lane-select **only** from canonical Job stage (§6BP.18 / §6BP.26). Remaining isolation:

- Legacy estimate-only spine remains a **separate** section — not a canonical DB lane
- Dashboard dollar metrics may still say “Scheduled” without showing a Scheduled lane
- Do **not** restore lane ownership from Proposal Sent / Proposal Signed / Ready to Schedule / deposit_paid / paid / Attention

### 6BP.20 Automatic transition atomicity

AUTO stage changes triggered by authoritative domain truth must be:

- **A.** Transactional with that domain write when practical, **or**
- **B.** Idempotent and safely reconcilable when cross-boundary transaction is impossible

Never allow: domain fact succeeds + best-effort UI stage update fails silently.

Examples: first proposal create → Intake→Proposal; clean formal accept → Proposal→Approved; R3F schedule confirm → Approved→Scheduled. Illegal edge: fail domain action or create explicit reconciliation Attention.

### 6BP.21 Guarded services (LIVE)

**`transition_job_stage_v1`:** authenticated + service_role EXECUTE; PUBLIC/anon denied; SECURITY DEFINER; `search_path=public`. Validates edge; requires durable truth; updates `jobs.stage` + `stage_entered_at`; writes job-native Activity; same-target is idempotent no-op (no clock reset, no duplicate Activity). **Sole writer** of `jobs.stage` after foundation.

**`change_job_disposition_v1`:** authenticated + service_role EXECUTE; PUBLIC/anon denied; SECURITY DEFINER; `search_path=public`. Operational targets: active / on_hold / lost / closed. Preserves stage + `stage_entered_at`; writes job-native Activity; reopen = active; won/archived rejected.

**`record_job_activity_v1`** and **`job_lifecycle_insert_activity`:** service_role only; authenticated denied.

Callers: first proposal create AUTO, explicit guarded RPCs, later formal acceptance / scheduling / production actions / future guarded board drag/drop / Copilot — **never** raw `jobs.stage` writes.

### 6BP.22 Legacy stage compatibility

Current DB CHECK: intake, measurement, estimating, proposal, approved, production, complete, archived.

**Future canonical writes:** intake, proposal, approved, scheduled, production, complete.

**Read mapping:** measurement → Intake; estimating → Intake; archived → §6BP.6 resolution.

**Phased approach:** add `scheduled` to CHECK at foundation; keep legacy values readable; guarded service bans writes to measurement/estimating/archived; backfill after verification; tighten CHECK later. Do **not** rush CHECK cleanup.

| 1 | Proposal | active | Sent | None | Customer question | Stage ≠ request |
| 2 | Proposal | active | Revision in progress | None | none | Still Proposal |
| 3 | Approved | active | Accepted | Deposit due | optional pay | Money ≠ stage |
| 4 | Scheduled | active | Accepted | Deposit paid | none | appointment Sep 14 on card |

## 6BR. R3D CUSTOMER PROPOSAL SIGNATURES — COMPLETE / LIVE (2026-08-16)

**Status:** **R3D SIGNATURES COMPLETE / LIVE / VERIFIED** on **`rhquhnujjnzjhweypavd`**.

### 6BR.1 Latest checkpoints

| Kind | Hash | Subject |
|------|------|---------|
| R3D code | **`0d06ad8`** | `feat(proposals): add customer proposal signatures` |
| Docs | **Pending this docs commit** | `docs: checkpoint customer proposal signatures` |

### 6BR.2 Architecture

**One customer experience, two immutable facts.**

| Fact | Owner | Meaning |
|------|-------|---------|
| **Acceptance** | `proposal_acceptances` | Exact frozen version / package / amount |
| **Signature** | `proposal_signatures` | Immutable execution evidence bound to that acceptance / version / option |

**First-time:** **Accept & sign** is **one atomic Postgres transaction** (`record_proposal_signature_v1` validates the payload, then calls `record_proposal_acceptance_v1`, then inserts/reuses the signature). If anything after acceptance fails, the whole transaction rolls back — no partial new acceptance survives.

**Already accepted:** Public shows **Proposal accepted** + **Sign proposal**. Signing **reuses** the matching acceptance. No second acceptance. No duplicate acceptance Attention.

**Signed does not move Job stage.** `jobs.stage` and `stage_entered_at` stay unchanged. Contractor **Approve job** remains the only Proposal → Approved writer.

### 6BR.3 `proposal_signatures`

Single V1 table. Logical uniqueness: `(company_id, proposal_acceptance_id, signer_slot)`.

**V1 signer slot:** `customer_primary` only.

**Signature evidence (immutable row):**
- printed name
- optional email
- typed name echo
- drawn mark JSON (version 1; max 24576 bytes / 24 strokes / 2–256 points per stroke / 1536 total points; normalized x/y in `[0,1]`)
- acknowledgement key + exact shown text
- `signed_at`
- `public_access_token_id` as **evidence** (token is not identity)

**Acknowledgement (product evidence, not lawyer-style contract language):**
- key: `fielddive_proposal_signature_v1`
- text: `I accept and sign this proposal as shown, including the selected package and total.`

Append-only. No ordinary UPDATE/DELETE. RLS ON. No anon/authenticated direct writes. `record_proposal_signature_v1` is **service_role EXECUTE only**.

**No `proposals.signed_version_id` writes.** Product Signed state comes only from `proposal_signatures`.

**No signature Attention merely as history.** First Accept & sign while Proposal opens the existing R3C **Approve job** Attention only. Signature itself does not create **Customer signed proposal**. Already Approved + later signature creates no signature Attention.

### 6BR.4 Activity / Job Card / Jobs Board

**Activity:** **Proposal signed**; chronology owner = `signed_at`; dedupe owner = signature id. Do not emit Signature opened / started / viewed / acknowledged. Retry does not duplicate Proposal signed.

**Job Card:** **Accepted** / **Signed** are subordinate proposal truths, not Job stage. Header can correctly be **Approved** with proposal **Signed**. Strip and Proposals-tab row share one owner.

**Jobs Board:** Accept and Sign do not move lanes. Attention does not move lanes. **Approve job** moves Proposal → Approved. No Signed lane. No signature-based board mapping.

### 6BR.5 Public

| State | Customer sees |
|-------|----------------|
| Unsigned | **Accept & sign** + Request this package + Ask a question |
| Accepted unsigned | **Proposal accepted** + **Sign proposal** + Request this package + Ask a question |
| Signed | **Proposal signed** (signed date + signer name) + Request this package + Ask a question |

No job stage, Attention, signature id, acceptance id, version UUID, token id, or signer slot on Public. No live Catalog/Template repricing. Request this package remains request-only.

**Revision:** V1 signature remains historical on V1. V2 requires a new acceptance/signature. No migration of signature truth.

## 6BT. R3F UNIFIED JOB SCHEDULING — COMPLETE / LIVE / VERIFIED (2026-08-17)

**Status:** **R3F COMPLETE / LIVE / VERIFIED** on **`rhquhnujjnzjhweypavd`**. Code checkpoint **`f876ed9`**. Migration **`20260817_045_job_schedules.sql`** is **LIVE / historical** and must not be edited in place.

### 6BT.1 Canonical architecture

- **`job_schedules` is the one scheduling owner.** There is no `jobs.scheduled_at` and no canonical `calendar_events` copy.
- At most one active `kind=work`, `status=scheduled` row exists per Job. The partial unique index enforces this under concurrency.
- Cancelled rows are immutable history and are never revived. Reschedule mutates the same active row; scheduling again after unschedule inserts a new row.
- Human truth is civil: inclusive `starts_on`, inclusive `ends_on`, IANA `timezone`, optional local times. Derived `range_start_at` is inclusive and `range_end_at` is exclusive.
- A schedule row retains its timezone snapshot. Later company-timezone changes do not reinterpret existing work.

### 6BT.2 Lifecycle ownership

- `schedule_job_v1` atomically owns **Approved → Scheduled** after inserting the active schedule row.
- `reschedule_job_v1` keeps the same row id, increments `row_version`, preserves the schedule timezone snapshot, and does not reset `stage_entered_at`.
- `unschedule_job_v1` atomically cancels the active row and owns **Scheduled → Approved**. Disposition is unchanged.
- Generic `transition_job_stage_v1` still cannot mint Scheduled.
- Unschedule cannot regress Production or Complete. Scheduling does not automatically start Production or Complete.

### 6BT.3 Product surfaces

- **Job Card:** compact Not scheduled / scheduled summary; Schedule, Reschedule, Unschedule; Calendar tab shows active work plus cancelled history.
- **Calendar:** Operations → Calendar; Month and Week only; company-civil visible bounds; bounded overlap reads; create from an empty date and reschedule via the shared modal. No Day view, crew, drag/drop, Google Calendar, or notifications.
- **Jobs Board:** canonical Scheduled lane; Approved cards schedule; Scheduled cards show canonical date/range metadata and can unschedule. Legacy/non-DB estimate cards cannot write an alternate local schedule truth.
- **Timezone setup:** missing timezone routes safely to Settings with origin, Job id, and date context; saving returns and reopens the scheduling flow. Browser timezone is never silently saved.
- **Activity:** durable `job_scheduled`, `job_rescheduled`, and `job_unscheduled`; paired lifecycle stage events remain durable but are suppressed as duplicate UI noise.
- No generic scheduling Attention is created.

### 6BT.4 Independence and security

- Payment and signature are read-only scheduling context, never prerequisites. An open deposit produces only quiet **Deposit not received** copy.
- No Stripe call or payment/signature write occurs while scheduling.
- RLS allows authenticated company-scoped SELECT. Anon cannot read; authenticated/anon raw INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE are denied.
- Approved SECURITY DEFINER RPCs enforce authenticated membership and company ownership. Internal lifecycle helpers are not exposed to authenticated/anon callers.
- No Public `/p` schedule read or write path exists.

## 6BU. R3G GUARDED PRODUCTION START — COMPLETE / LIVE / VERIFIED (2026-08-18)

**Status:** **R3G COMPLETE / LIVE / VERIFIED** on **`rhquhnujjnzjhweypavd`**. Code checkpoint **`a175814`**. Docs checkpoint is this commit. Migration **`20260817_046_job_production_start.sql`** is **LIVE / historical** and must not be edited in place.

### 6BU.1 Canonical architecture

- **`jobs.production_started_at`** is the one actual-start timestamp. There is no `job_production` table, no `production_status`, and no `actual_completed_at`.
- Production start is an explicit contractor **Start work** action. Scheduling never auto-starts Production or Complete.
- `start_job_work_v1` atomically owns **Scheduled → Production**, sets `production_started_at = stage_entered_at = transaction_timestamp()`, and requires exactly one active canonical work schedule.
- Generic `transition_job_stage_v1` still cannot mint Production (`production_blocked_until_start_work`).
- The active `job_schedules` row remains planned truth. Start work does not reschedule, unschedule, or rewrite civil dates. Early and late starts are both valid calendar variance.

### 6BU.2 Product surfaces

- **Job Card:** Scheduled shows planned window + primary **Start work** with Reschedule / Unschedule. Production shows **Work started** with authoritative DB time and **Planned · …**; Reschedule / Unschedule / Start work / Complete are absent.
- **Jobs Board:** Scheduled cards expose the same Start work API. Production cards show planned context and **Work started**. Legacy **Start Job** / `in_progress` / crew-on-site copy is retired from the canonical path.
- **Calendar:** Month and Week keep the same `job_schedules` event. Production is a presentation/stage treatment only. No Start-work Calendar action. No duplicated Production event. Production/Complete clicks open the Job Card; Calendar remains planning truth.
- **Activity:** durable `job_work_started` is the visible fact. Paired `stage_changed(reason=work_started)` remains durable but is suppressed as adjacent **Moved to Production** noise. Idempotent retry does not duplicate Activity.

### 6BU.3 Independence and security

- Payment and signature are read-only context, never Start-work prerequisites. Quiet **Deposit not received** appears on Scheduled when a deposit is due. No R3E/R3D mutation.
- Raw authenticated `jobs.stage` / `production_started_at` writes are blocked. Anon cannot execute the RPC. Cross-company is `forbidden`.
- `on_hold` / `lost` / `closed` block Start work (`disposition_blocks_start_work`). Production then `on_hold` keeps stage and timestamp.
- No crew, daily logs, pause, work-order, or photo production domain was added.

### 6BU.4 Live verification

## 6CA. RUNTIME OWNERSHIP HARDENING — JOB CARD GRAPH + BOARD JOBS-FIRST + TRUTHFUL ERRORS (2026-08-24)

**Status:** **Runtime ownership COMPLETE.** Code checkpoint **`2ae31a0`** (`refactor(app): reduce runtime critical paths`). Docs checkpoint pending this commit. **No migration.** **No lifecycle truth change.** **No push.**

This stage closes that layer in one pass.

### 6CA.1 Job Card critical graph split

**Old eager Job Card path:** `/tools/roofing?entry=job-card&job=` statically imported `RoofingClient`, which evaluated catalog store, pdf-lib / estimate send, templates, measurement, legacy estimator, and `RoofingClientV2` before first usable.

**New ownership:**

```
Roofing route shell (page.tsx)
→ isCleanJobCardRoute(entry=job-card + job + no loadSaved)
→ dynamic import JobCardClient
→ packet / instant / loadSaved still dynamic-import RoofingClient
```

`JobCardClient` owns Job identity, canonical stage, disposition, lifecycle eligibility, schedule read/settlement (PERF-1), timezone, payments strip, Attention, Start/Complete, schedule modal, proposals list, Activity. Secondary tabs load via `next/dynamic` → `JobCardSecondaryPanels` (`ssr: false`). Display types live in `jobCardDisplayTypes.ts` so Header/Metadata/Overview do not import `jobsBoardUtils` → `estimateStore`.

`RoofingClient` V2 is now `dynamic(() => import("../roofing-v2/RoofingClientV2"), { ssr: false })` on the estimator path.

### 6CA.2 Eager imports removed from the clean Job Card client

`JobCardClient` does **not** statically import: `pdf-lib`, `catalogStore`, `defaultRoofingCatalog`, `estimateStore`, `sendEstimateClient`, `RoofingClientV2`, `ProposalBuilderClient`, catalog-setup client. Those remain on the RoofingClient / builder / catalog routes. Template setup on the clean card is a secondary dynamic panel.

### 6CA.3 Board jobs-first

**Old:** `useCompanySetupReadiness` ran with canonical jobs and contended Board first paint (branding, pricing, full catalog, all templates, estimates/setup).

**New:**

- `coreBoardReady = hydrated && dbJobsStatus === "ready"`
- `useCompanySetupReadiness(companyId, { enabled: coreBoardReady })`
- `data-board-core-ready` / `data-board-secondary-setup-ready`

Canonical jobs and first Kanban paint do not wait for setup. Setup banner remains. Setup failure cannot block jobs. Jobs failure remains a truthful Board error (no fabricated emptiness).

### 6CA.4 Truthful Job Card error states

**Schedule:** `loading | ready_with_schedule | ready_without_schedule | error`. Only a successful empty canonical read may show **Not scheduled**. No invented schedule. RPC guards unchanged. PERF-1: error still enables secondary; Complete still needs a planned schedule.

**Proposal list:** `loading | ready_empty | ready_items | error`. Failure keeps last-known-good. Empty + error shows **Proposals unavailable** (`data-jobcard-proposals-unavailable`), not **No proposals yet**.

## 6CB. R3I CONTRACTOR DISPOSITION MANAGEMENT — COMPLETE / VERIFIED / LOCKED (2026-08-26)

**Status:** **R3I COMPLETE / VERIFIED / LOCKED**. Code checkpoint **`6426c6a`** (`feat(jobs): add contractor disposition management`). Docs checkpoint is this commit. **No migration.** **039 reserved / absent. 047 SHA unchanged. 048 absent.**

### 6CB.1 Product direction lock

FieldDive is currently optimized for smaller contractors who need speed, professionalism, automation, fewer administrative steps, and the ability to compete with larger companies without adopting large-company bureaucracy.

Do **not** introduce enterprise-style modules or workflows as the next stage.

- **Work Orders** are **not** a committed product stage.
- **Full Invoicing** is **not** a committed product stage.
- These should only be introduced later if actual contractor workflow proves they remove more work than they create.

Material Orders, Job Costing, Photos + roof measurement automation + automatic measurement integration, and Copilot remain future core capabilities and must not be displaced by enterprise administrative structure.

**Corrected forward roadmap after R3I:**

1. Board interaction / guarded drag-and-drop
2. Payment experience completion
3. Proposal / sales-flow completion
4. Scheduling / production experience completion
5. Photos + roof measurement automation + automatic measurement integration
6. Copilot
7. Material Orders
8. Job Costing

Any later module must be justified by actual contractor workflow, not by traditional CRM / ERP expectations.

### 6CB.2 Canonical contract (existing `change_job_disposition_v1`)

Disposition answers “What is the business disposition of this job?” Lifecycle stage answers “Where is this job operationally?” They must never be conflated.

Canonical operational status values: **`active`**, **`on_hold`**, **`lost`**, **`closed`**.

RPC payload: `company_id`, `job_id`, `to_status`, optional `reason`. No source-disposition restriction — any operational status may go to any other, including **Reactivate** as `to_status = 'active'`. Same-target is idempotent. RPC preserves `jobs.stage` and `stage_entered_at`. It does **not** write `production_started_at`, `completed_at`, or `job_schedules`. Reason persists only in the Activity `disposition_changed` payload, not on `jobs`. Complete remains lifecycle terminal V1; Close is a separate disposition and is not implied by Complete.

### 6CB.3 Surfaces

- **API:** authenticated `POST /api/jobs/change-disposition` (`{ jobId, toStatus, reason? }`). Company ownership is server-side (`getUser` + `getUserCompanyId`). Does not trust client company id.
- **Job Card:** restrained **Job actions** control beside stage/disposition metadata. Active → Put on hold / Mark lost / Close job. Non-active → **Reactivate** only (UI narrower than RPC any-to-any). Compact confirm dialog; optional reason (max 240). Close copy does not claim work was Completed unless stage is actually Complete. ACTIVE is visually quiet. Non-active shows paired stage + disposition plus Reactivate copy. No optimistic fake status; pending disables duplicate clicks; refresh then known `to_status` patch if refresh fails.
- **Board:** lanes remain lifecycle stage. Compact non-active badges. Disposition filter (All / Active / On hold / Lost / Closed) on canonical DB jobs; legacy estimates fenced.
- **Activity:** one RPC `disposition_changed` event; composer labels: Job put on hold / Job marked lost / Job closed / Job reactivated. No client duplicate write.
- **Attention:** disposition is not automatically Attention. Existing Attention continues to respect Stage AB eligibility.
- **Calendar:** disposition does not cancel/reschedule. Planned schedule remains. Event click → Job Card.

Controlled fixture **`[R3G-046] Mobile Scheduled`** `3338cd5c-6427-4546-9014-9ada70f595a1` (Scheduled + active; planned work `c8810eae-7c26-4912-9e2e-10e4a64ad8a7`; Attention 0).

- Hold → stage Scheduled, status `on_hold`, `stage_entered_at` unchanged, clocks/schedule unchanged, one `disposition_changed`, Attention still 0. Idempotent same-target hold → `idempotent: true`.
- Reactivate → status `active`, stage still Scheduled, clocks/schedule unchanged. Fixture restored to **active**.
- Display fixtures (not remutated): Blocked Hold / Lost / Closed.
- UI: Job actions, Escape restores focus, dialog focus, Board Scheduled + On hold badge, Board → Job Card, direct URL + reload, true **390×844** (`innerWidth === 390`, no horizontal overflow).

### 6CF.2 Transition matrix (drag is intent only)

Drag never writes `jobs.stage`. Every successful move uses the same canonical action/RPC as the rest of FieldDive.

| Drag | Means | Owner |
|------|--------|--------|
| Intake → Proposal | proposal-create intent | Job Card Proposals tab (`tab=proposals&from=board`) |
| Proposal → Approved | Approve job (only if `canApproveJob`) | `POST /api/jobs/confirm-acceptance` after **Approve job?** |
| Approved → Scheduled | open Stage A workspace; **no invented date** | `schedule_job_v1` after contractor picks dates |
| Scheduled → Production | Start work | `start_job_work_v1` after **Start work?** |
| Production → Complete | Complete job | `complete_job_work_v1` after **Complete job?** |
| Scheduled → Approved | Unschedule | `unschedule_job_v1` after **Unschedule job?** — active schedule removed from calendar; job returns to Approved; existing **Schedule job** cue; cancelled history preserved (not deleted) |

All other forward skips and backward moves: **BLOCKED** (no DB write, no Activity write, card stays in source lane). Complete is **TERMINAL**. Non-active (`on_hold` / `lost` / `closed`): **Reactivate to continue.** Missing Schedule negative fixture: Start/Complete blocked.

### 6CF.3 Interaction model

- Desktop Board: native pointer drag (no new package). Mouse-only; threshold distinguishes click (Job Card) from drag (lifecycle intent). Temporary ghost/preview only — destination lane changes only after RPC + coalesced refresh.
- Valid/invalid drop targets are restrained (no arcade glow).
- Lightweight confirms; Escape cancels; focus restores; pending announced.

## 6CG. PAYMENT STAGE 1 — AGREEMENT TERMS + JOB-LEVEL LEDGER + ACCEPT/SIGN/PAY DEPOSIT (2026-08-26)

**Status:** **COMPLETE / VERIFIED / LOCKED**. Code **`e168d88`** (`feat(payments): add proposal payment terms and job ledger`). Docs: this section. **No push. No package. 039 reserved / absent. 044 SHA unchanged (`9E098700C57228442B28C44E6177C5630456912A207CA55B1A5DCB1F7CBDB09F`). 047 SHA unchanged (`FFE33FDD562742519BB92568CD5C55528537EA756540D1C6C906F8694B974979`). Migration `20260826_048_proposal_payment_terms_and_job_ledger.sql` LIVE on `rhquhnujjnzjhweypavd` SHA256 `72B46B61050287B094478485986772898BB0753FC0F1712D2825D9581A4BDCF0`.**

R3E deposit Checkout + webhook settlement remain the collection spine. Stage 1 adds proposal-owned terms, freeze, send readiness, auto-open deposit on accept, job-level ledger, and method-language lock. Board/Calendar stay payment-free. Refunds remain Stage 3 + elevated permission. Payments tab / invoices / milestones / change orders / financing are **not** started.

### 6CG.1 Ownership

| Surface | Owns |
|---------|------|
| Settings | Company **default** deposit only — prefills **new drafts**. Never rewrites sent/accepted/historical terms. |
| Builder | Proposal-specific draft terms (`none` / `percent` / `fixed`). Lean control; remaining balance always **due on completion**. |
| Preview | Contractor sees the same customer-facing terms copy. |
| Send freeze | Terms copy onto the new sent/signed version from the parent draft. Sent-version terms are immutable. |
| Public | Customer sees terms **before** Accept. After accept, **Pay deposit** if a deposit is due. Combined **Accept & sign** remains the public primary agreement CTA (R3D). |
| Stripe | Payment-method presentation (Checkout APM + card fallback). FieldDive never promises card/ACH/Cash App in the Pay CTA. |
| FieldDive | Obligation language: **Pay deposit** / **Pay remaining balance**; deposit due upon acceptance; remaining due upon completion. |

V1 collection channel is **online Stripe only** (`collection_channel` locked). No fake offline selector.

### 6CG.2 Ledger and revision

Job-level money: gross received / refunded / net received / current contractual total (latest `accepted_at`, not `confirmed_at`) / remaining.

Revision additional deposit = `max(0, current_terms_deposit_cents − job_net_received)`, capped to remaining contractual total. Slice &lt; $1.00 → no new request. V2 `none` → additional = 0 (remainder is Stage 2 balance).

Example: V1 $15,000 / $5,000 received → V2 $17,000 / 30% ($5,100) → additional **$100**. Job remaining **$12,000**.

Acceptance is valid without payment. Deposit auto-opens on accept (not contractor “Request deposit”). Payment never writes `jobs.stage`. Contractor Approve remains lifecycle only. Job Card `canRequestDeposit` still requires Approve (044 read-model lock); auto-open owns the initial deposit; Job Card **shows** due without Approve.

Supersession: old `open`/`failed` requests on other acceptances are cancelled (processing left alone). Checkout resolve blocks when the request acceptance is not the latest or the token version is not the latest accepted version. Successful money is retained.

### 6CG.3 Stripe / Checkout

Checkout creates with `automatic_payment_methods: { enabled: true }` (SDK 17.5 types require a cast) and falls back to `payment_method_types: ["card"]`. No Cash App hard-code. Direct-charge connected account preserved. Amounts are server-derived. Webhook remains settlement owner. Settled method label (`Visa •••• 4242` / `Cash App Pay` / `Bank payment`) is written from provider objects only after the event is recorded. Pending ACH is never Received.

### 6CG.4 Proof

Focused Stage 1 + regression **596/596** pass (037/040–047, freeze, public orchestrator, Send gate, packet CTA, signatures, acceptance, Board movement, Stage A workspace, R3I, PERF-1, Wave 2). Inherited noise not in this batch: `proposalSendPrep.server.test.ts` stale `/Copy customer send link/` source assertion (documented since V2F); `jobsBoardOverviewMetrics.test.ts` date-dependent `stalled_30d`. Touched-file lint: no new errors in Stage 1 files; PreviewClient still has inherited react-hooks/compiler errors on the existing `loadPreview` effect / `sentRequest` memo. Filtered typecheck: no errors in Stage 1 files (repo has inherited catalog/proposal test TS noise). `git diff --check` clean.
